div.div:
Scenario: The VIP (customer #2) arrives on turn 4, as set in the base setting (Regular, VIP, Regular, Critic, Regular, Regular).
The manager's choice is whether to turn on Happy Hour at the start of turn 4.
- If the manager says no, the VIP pays $13.50 (15 x 0.90).
- If the manager says yes, the VIP pays $10.80 (15 x 0.90 x 0.80). Any customer still waiting for a table or food also gets 15 satisfaction back on turns 4 and 5 (max 100).
c:VIPCustomer is this VIP. :Customer stands for any customer, since the loops go through everyone.
The VIP discount and the lower waiting loss (5) come from VIPCustomer itself, so GameController never has to check the customer type.
